answer.main_body: stone fireplace with mantel and hearth
answer.evidence: The stone chimney and fireplace structure is drawn entirely in pure front elevation with no visible top surface at the top of the body (cuts off flat at row 0). The fireplace is rendered in flat front elevation. The main stone structure extends vertically with no top surface visible (top_rows: 0), and the wooden mantel shelf only has a 1px top edge line (row 9) above its 3px front face instead of a properly foreshortened horizontal surface.
